title: 第161章 寻凰青觅得巾谨收心收身收祸端第160章 冰晶阵照见自我凰青归梦收巾谨
content_zh:
再望向水晶球里的大谨巾，陌生感果然又重了几分。
与此同时，循环播放的全息影像里，凰青所属时空的背景画面也彻底消失。
没过多久，全息影像里骤然闪过凰蓝位置对应的背景图景。
几乎同一瞬，“七曜命轮”上凰蓝的虚影旁，凭空撑开一道时空传送通道。
不用多想，这是指引我去寻回凰蓝，重回正途。
这一趟，我打算带上菁琎、凰红、凰橙、凰黄、凰绿、凰青，连同芬宁、芳宁和“速宁飞刀”一起走。
“天地之间”与羞厵已和我的“灵识空间”绑定，“天赐”连同羞画、羞图又锚定在“天地之间”上，自然只能一并带上。
一切准备妥当，我再次跨入传送通道。
眼前骤然一黑，我彻底失去了意识。
等我悠悠醒转，发现自己赤身躺在一片草地上。
“灵识空间”居然变成了只进不出的状态。
“阴阳空间”“灵玉空间”也跟着一并到了这里，同样只能进、不能出。
难道……
我心念微动，稚倪、诗倪、迷倪立刻显现在身侧。
这里是“纯阳世界”！
我低头望去，心口正悬浮着几十枚淡青色的“师”“翌”“恒”印记。
夏冰、盛火、师妃、吉珈、意灵、棂灵、安芯、荚卉、煜龄、子瀛、湘洛、绣纹、煦熹、钰璇、铃玲、灵慧、灵靓、艳萩、鑫乐、艳娇、艳魅、菁鱼、歆艳、稚倪、仙鹓、幻符、书缨、欤冰、“珍恋”……一个个名字顺着印记在我脑海里闪过。
一瞬间我彻底反应过来。
这是我第一次踏入“纯阳世界”、100%概率死亡的那条时间线。
这一回，我是跟着“纯阳世界”的轮回重生的，并非当初缨珊靠“0%概率存活的量子涨落”把我救回来的那次。

这该是一条全新的时间线。
我到这里不能改动太多，否则会引发因果冲突。
尤其是心口这些印记对应的人，都有可能因此被因果抹除。
这次过来别无他求，找到凰蓝就立刻返程。
“七曜命轮”上，凰蓝的印记已经亮起辉光，她必定就在这个世界里。
这个世界以百万年为一个周期不断轮回。
我还有近百万年的时间，可以慢慢找凰蓝。
凰绿当初依附在“炼蛊鼎”里，也就是我的肾脏之上；
凰青藏身在一粒细沙中，从天地初开时就等着我找过去；
那凰蓝又会藏在什么地方？
在这个世界里，我所有灵体都处于激活状态，还维持着曾经的最高层级。
心念一动，所有分身、化身、侍卫、护卫尽数飞散出去，顷刻间覆盖了整颗星球。
我“分心多用”，1万亿道神念同时铺开，每一寸土地、每一片海域、每一处秘境、每一个生灵，都尽数纳入我的感知范围。
没有凰蓝的气息。
难道她在其他星球上？
造飞船去找？
就算任意星球都能一念抵达，要搜遍整个宇宙，哪怕百万年一刻不停，也连亿万分之一的范围都覆盖不到。
既然“七曜命轮”指引我来这里，那凰蓝的线索必定就在此处。
正巧前方发现一个原始部落，先落脚安顿下来再从长计议。
反正有百万年时间，不急在这一时。

……
我让稚倪、诗倪、迷倪打扮得鲜亮些，都戴上面纱，跟着我一同去往部落。
content_en:
Looking at the large scarf in the crystal ball again, the strangeness is indeed a bit stronger.
At the same time, in the holographic image that was played in a loop, the background image of Huang Qing's time and space also completely disappeared.
Not long after, the background image corresponding to Huang Lan's position flashed across the holographic image.
Almost at the same moment, a space-time transmission channel was opened out of thin air next to Huang Lan's shadow on the "Qi Yao Life Wheel".
No need to think too much, this is a guide for me to find Huanglan and get back on the right path.
On this trip, I plan to take Jingjing, Huanghong, Huangcheng, Huanghuang, Huanglu, Huangqing, along with Fenning, Fangning and "Suning Flying Knife".
"Between Heaven and Earth" and Shame have been bound to my "spiritual consciousness space", and "God-given" together with shame paintings and shame pictures are anchored in "Between Heaven and Earth", so naturally I can only take them with me.
With everything ready, I stepped into the transmission channel again.
My eyes suddenly went dark, and I completely lost consciousness.
When I woke up leisurely, I found myself lying naked on a piece of grass.
The "spiritual consciousness space" has actually become a state that can only be entered but not exited.
The "Yin Yang Space" and "Ling Jade Space" also arrived here, and they can only enter but not exit.
Could it be...
My thoughts moved slightly, and Zhi Ni, Shi Ni, and Mi Ni immediately appeared beside me.
This is the "Pure Yang World"!
I looked down and saw dozens of light cyan "Shi", "Yi" and "Heng" marks floating in my heart.
Xia Bing, Sheng Huo, Shi Fei, Ji Jia, Yi Ling, Ling Ling, An Xin, Ji Hui, Yu Ling, Zi Ying, Xiang Luo, Xiu Wen, Xu Xi, Yu Xuan, Ling Ling, Ling Hui, Ling Jing, Yan Ha .
I completely reacted in an instant.
This is the timeline where I first stepped into the "Pure Yang World" and had a 100% probability of death.
This time, I was reborn following the reincarnation of the "Pure Yang World", not the time when Yingshan saved me by relying on "quantum fluctuations with 0% probability of survival".
This should be a new timeline.
I can't change too much here, otherwise it will cause a cause and effect conflict.
Especially those who correspond to these marks on the heart may be wiped out by cause and effect.
This time I came here for no other reason than to return immediately after finding Huang Lan.
On the "Qi Yao Life Wheel", Huang Lan's mark has glowed, she must be in this world.
This world keeps reincarnating in cycles of millions of years.
I still have nearly a million years to slowly find Huang Lan.
Huanglu was originally attached to the "Gu Refining Cauldron", which was my kidney;
Huang Qing is hiding in a grain of fine sand, waiting for me to find her since the beginning of the world;
Where would Huang Lan be hiding?
In this world, all my spiritual bodies are in an activated state and still maintain the highest level they have ever had.
With a thought, all the clones, incarnations, guards, and escorts flew out, covering the entire planet in an instant.
I am "distracted and multipurpose", and 1 trillion spiritual thoughts are spread out at the same time. Every inch of land, every sea area, every secret realm, and every living creature is included in my perception.
There is no aura of Huanglan.
Could she be on another planet?
Build a spaceship to find it?
Even if any planet can be reached with a single thought, if we want to search the entire universe, even if it takes millions of years without stopping, we will not be able to cover even one billionth of the range.
Since the "Qi Yao Fate Wheel" guided me here, then Huang Lan's clue must be here.
We happened to find a primitive tribe ahead, so we decided to settle down first and then make long-term plans.
Anyway, I have a million years, so there is no rush now.
…
I asked Zhi Ni, Shi Ni, and Mi Ni to dress up brightly, put on veils, and follow me to the tribe.
